Subject: Post-demo follow-up: stakeholder roster, procurement path & POC kickoff

Hi Anna — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and asks so we have a clean MAP to share with your team.

What I heard (high-level)
- Primary business priority: reduce inference cost and latency for chart summarization pipeline (target: real-time <250ms for 1–2k token responses).
- Timeline: internal approval and procurement decision expected in May–June window; POC desired in late May.
- Key stakeholders: you (product lead), Lisa Monroe (CFO, final approver), procurement (Michael Graves). Security/compliance will need SOC 2 & DPA review.

Immediate asks
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and their preferred cadence (Lisa or someone else)?
2) Procurement window: when can legal/procurement complete a draft DPA review? Any blackout dates?
3) Any environment constraints for the POC (VPC, data residency, sample data availability)?

Attached: a first-pass MAP draft (redwood-map-draft.pdf), a short SOC 2 summary (soc2-summary.pdf), and a ballpark pricing estimate (pricing-estimate.xlsx). I also dropped a lightweight MAP v1 into Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-MAP-v1

Proposed next steps (if this aligns):
- Wed 5/5: 30-min sync with procurement + security to align on DPA & evidence list.
- Mon 5/10: POC kickoff (2-week POC, success criteria: <250ms median latency on sample perf run, integration with S3 ingest).
- End of POC: decision checkpoint and pricing discussion.

If that looks good I can loop in Connor (POC lead) and Neha (security/compliance) and we’ll book the procurement sync.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi team — quick POC milestone draft based on Hannah’s notes and BlueWave constraints. Pls review and flag changes; I’ll convert this into the MAP table and drop back into Drive.

POC: 2-week focused evaluation (target kickoff: Mon 5/10)
Milestones:
1) Day 0–2: Environment setup — VPC peering established, staging S3 access, test account credentials. Acceptance: successful S3 ingest of sanitized files.
2) Day 3–6: Integration & model run — integrate Redwood SDK, run baseline perf tests. Acceptance: sample run completes and median latency <250ms for 1–2k tokens.
3) Day 7–10: Functionality & quality checks — validate chart summarization outputs against annotated sample set. Acceptance: >=85% accuracy on targeted rubric and no PHI leaks.
4) Day 11–14: Reporting & handoff — deliver performance report, cost estimate based on observed tokens, and recommended production config. Acceptance: executive summary for Lisa + procurement packet.

Dependencies / asks from BlueWave:
- Provide sanitized sample dataset (S3 path) by 5/7.
- Confirm VPC peering window and contact for infra (IP ranges).

I’ll draft a short 1-page acceptance checklist and upload to the Drive link by EOD. Connor
